notes.title: Wealdfall Squirrel Release
notes.content:
The day has come for the Wealdfall Squirrel to be unleashed upon the world. Prepare to face the challenges of the wilds and overcome the difficulties of the squirrel's life. Traverse the forests, climb the waterfalls and descend the mountains in your life's mission to eat hazelnuts. Are you prepared to unleash your inner squirrel? Prove yourself to be the epitome of squirrelity.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45158962/0f4562d111d830eeae3eef497e8fbc3da126b19f.png[/img]
